acceptance_criterion.claim: selected candidate is worth experimental validation
acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Matches the supplied E4 composition at one-third scale, but E4 has no supplied thermal-hold measurements.
Matches the supplied E5 composition at one-third scale; the E5 reference showed substantially greater 120 C hold increase than E1 over 15-60 min.

selection_rationale: S1C01 is the exact one-third-scale composition of E1, which had the supplied lower 120 C hold drift: viscosity increased from 708.7 at 15 min to 776.1 at 60 min. This makes it the most directly supported candidate, while recognizing that the candidate itself has not been measured.

evidence_coverage.note: Only E1 and E5 have supplied thermal-hold measurements; most candidates lack directly corresponding hold data.

extrapolation.note: Selection transfers reference behavior to a one-third-scale candidate composition without direct candidate validation.

measurement.note: No direct measurements are supplied for any candidate.

process_history.note: Candidate processing history is not supplied.
